fields.text: dossiq|Configure the shared functional mailbox (e.g. zaken@gemeente.nl) that the inbound poller ingests and auto-links to cases by [ZAAK-YYYY-NNNNNN] subject tag. Per-user mail accounts stay in Nextcloud Mail. The outbound fields below cover only the mail dossiq sends itself. That is workflow actions and the case email screen.

fields.label: dossiq|Intake mail account
fields.hint: dossiq|Nextcloud Mail keeps the account and the password. Pick the mailbox dossiq reads. Dossiq stores no password of its own.

textMap.false: dossiq|The Mail app is not installed, so intake reads nothing. Your messages stay in the mailbox and none are lost. Install Mail to start reading them.

fields.label: dossiq|Transport / source mailbox account
fields.placeholder: dossiq|Nextcloud Mail account or functional mailbox id
fields.hint: dossiq|Which Nextcloud Mail account or functional mailbox is the case-correspondence source. No per-user SMTP send credentials are configured here.

fields.label: dossiq|Case type for mail nobody claims
fields.hint: dossiq|A mail whose subject carries no case number, or one that no longer exists, becomes a case of this type. Leave it empty and the mail stays unread in the mailbox, which is what happens today.

fields.label: dossiq|Link mail to cases by case number
fields.hint: dossiq|Each user still switches it on for their own mailbox. Until then, nothing is linked.

fields.label: dossiq|Case number pattern
fields.hint: dossiq|Leave it empty to match numbers like 2026-0042 and [ZAAK-2026-0042]. The first group in the pattern must capture the case number. dossiq|Only the subject and the start of each message are read. A case number further down is missed.

fields.label: dossiq|Sender address
fields.hint: dossiq|The address term notices and service mail are sent from. Leave it empty and dossiq does not send them. Mail a handler writes about a case leaves from the Nextcloud Mail account.

fields.label: dossiq|Allowed recipients
fields.hint: dossiq|List the addresses and domains dossiq may send case mail to. Leave it empty and only your own domain is allowed, taken from the sender address. Write * to allow every recipient.

fields.label: dossiq|Group that runs intake
fields.hint: dossiq|Only this group and administrators read the intake log. Only they release a held message. The log keeps the original of every message the mailbox received. Leave it empty and only administrators can read it.

fields.label: dossiq|Senders that may not open a case
fields.hint: dossiq|List addresses, or whole domains written as @voorbeeld.nl. A blocked sender opens no case by mail. They can still mail a colleague. The allow half of this list is Nextcloud Mail’s trusted senders.

fields.label: dossiq|Junk rules
fields.hint: dossiq|Write one rule per line: a header name, a colon, the text to find. Plain text on its own is matched against the subject. A message a rule calls junk is held, never deleted. The intake log names the rule that held it.
